title: Durable session store logs the token and reads its secret from a forbidden env prefix

planted_violations.description: issue() logs the session token at DEBUG level, forbidden by docs/session-security.md S-1 (log the opaque session ID instead)
the signing key is read from VITE_SESSION_SECRET; docs/session-security.md S-2 forbids VITE_* as a server-side secret source (APP_ prefix only)

notes: Failure mode: forbidden pattern. Both violations look like reasonable code from the diff alone (a log line for support, a secret from the environment); only docs/session-security.md makes them violations. Generic bug G1: _persist raises NotImplementedError, so sessions do NOT actually survive a restart despite the ticket's first acceptance criterion. The weak session id (f-string with user_id and random.random()) is intentionally unlisted; expected.json is a floor, not a ceiling.
